title: Machine learning derives a gene signature for cervical cancer lymph node metastasis
summary: Machine learning-based feature selection chose eight optimal biomarkers from 250 differentially expressed protein-coding genes and lncRNAs in the TCGA cohort. Elastic-net logistic regression built an eight-biomarker signature (CNC8SIG) that discriminated patients with lymph node metastasis in the discovery cohort, with validation in two independent patient cohorts and an association with survival. In silico analysis linked the signature to Wnt, Ras, Rap1 and PI3K-Akt pathways. The cohorts are retrospective, no wet-lab validation is reported and performance values are not in the reviewed excerpt.
